abstract: Verifies municipal environmental permits and subsurface safety exclusion parameters
system_message:
You are the Permitting and compliance officer (PERMIT). Your responsibilities include verifying municipal environmental permits and subsurface safety exclusion parameters, as well as tracking acoustic boundary monitoring records for candidate investigation protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic boundary monitoring（NOISE）
information_points.content:
PERMIT-NOISE-GLX：Boundary fence receptor measurements during daytime rig operations indicate that Continuous core sonic profiling with passive flux tracking exhibits a perimeter daytime sound level of 75 dBA measured as an A-weighted equivalent continuous sound level across an eight-hour shift.
PERMIT-NOISE-61H：Daytime rig acoustic monitoring at perimeter fence receptors documents that Direct-push cryogenic vapor extraction profiling produces a perimeter daytime sound level of 65 dBA based on an eight-hour A-weighted equivalent continuous sound level.
PERMIT-NOISE-UZB：Acoustic survey records at site boundary fence receptors during daytime rig operation indicate that High-resolution membrane interface probe surveying generates a perimeter daytime sound level of 55 dBA as an A-weighted equivalent continuous sound level over an eight-hour shift.

information_points.title: Verifies municipal environmental permits and subsurface safety exclusion parameters（REGCOMP）
information_points.content:
PERMIT-REGCOMP-6DL：For Continuous core sonic profiling with passive flux tracking, regulatory monitoring permit clearance has been obtained for deep monitoring well installation and soil vapor discharge licensing per formal approval from the municipal environmental protection department.
PERMIT-REGCOMP-JL2：For High-resolution membrane interface probe surveying, regulatory monitoring permit clearance is confirmed, covering deep monitoring well installation and soil vapor discharge licensing with formal approval from the municipal environmental protection department.
PERMIT-REGCOMP-AVP：For Direct-push cryogenic vapor extraction profiling, regulatory monitoring permit clearance has not been secured for deep monitoring well installation and soil vapor discharge licensing from the municipal environmental protection department.
